full_translation_en:
House of Representatives
Notice Paper 1
Date: 2083 Bhadra 16, Tuesday
Notice Regarding the Meeting
Regarding the meeting of the House of Representatives which was postponed until further notice by Notice Paper-1 published on 2083 Bhadra 11, the Honorable Speaker has scheduled the meeting of the House of Representatives to be held on Wednesday, 2083 Bhadra 17, at 1:00 PM, in accordance with Rule 6, Sub-rule (3) of the House of Representatives Regulations, 2083. This notice is published for the information of the Honorable Members.
Padma Prasad Pandey
Secretary-General

sections.name: Opening
sections.summary_en: A notice is published informing the Honorable Members that the House of Representatives meeting, previously postponed, has been rescheduled by the Honorable Speaker. The meeting is set to convene on Wednesday, 2083 Bhadra 17, at 1:00 PM, as per the House of Representatives Regulations.
key_issues: Rescheduling of House of Representatives meeting
